question: With what restriction must the ray circle be satisfied in worship?
premises: The verse addresses the goddess as lady of the gods.
It refers to satisfying the ray circle.
It prohibits using any other vessel for this act.
inference: The ray circle must not be satisfied with any other vessel than the one designated.
uncertainties: The specific designated vessel for the ray circle is not named in this verse.
plain_english: O lady of the gods, one should not satisfy the ray circle with any other vessel.
